data.one_liner: A tree-view package focusing on tree data structures and UI visualization.
data.what_it_does: Builds tree data structures and visualizes them as inheritance trees (stack views or expandable tree views) with built-in helper and update functions.
use_when: You need to display hierarchical tree data structures in Flutter
You require custom tree-view operations like searching, single/multiple choice, and lazy loading
avoid_when: You are using a state management system and prefer built-in reactive tree widgets
strengths: Prioritizes robust tree data structures independent of UI
Supports special UI styles, lazy-loading, and search operations
weaknesses: Does not use a state management library out of the box, requiring manual callbacks for state updates
